changelog:
xianyu-auto-lister 1.0.0 released!

- Initial release of the Xianyu auto-listing assistant, providing optimized product titles, descriptions, pricing suggestions, and recommended posting times.
- Features include AI-powered title optimization, automated description generation, pricing strategy, traffic tag suggestion, and image tips.
- Supports both individual and business product templates, with strategies to maximize exposure and conversion rates on Xianyu.
- Includes detailed guides on optimal listing times, photo tips, and best practices for increasing sales performance.
- Batch optimization available for monthly and yearly plan users; supports all product categories.
